from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single judgment document required for classification."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of the judgment document as provided")
    case_nature: str | None = Field(description="The broad legal nature of the case (e.g., 民事，刑事，行政)")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The specific legal cause of action, charge, or dispute type identified in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentInfo]
